The Panthers' offensive line is decimated by injuries (Damien Lewis, Rasheed Walker), leaving Bryce Young vulnerable. Green Bay's defense, while missing Micah Parsons, still boasts a strong front (Karl Brooks, Chris McClellan) and experienced linebackers (Lukas Van Ness). Carolina's defense lacks depth in the secondary (Akayleb Evans, Jaelan Phillips out) and will struggle to contain Packers' WRs. Special teams are evenly matched, but Packers' home-field advantage and superior depth secure the win. The Packers' ability to control time of possession and limit Carolina's explosive plays will dictate the outcome. Final score: Green Bay 24, Carolina 17.
